verdict.rationale: Foreloop is a SaaS work-management platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its docs say it serves MCP at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP, and an MCP client needs only that URL plus an API key. Keys are created per integration under Settings → Connections, and agents such as Claude Code and Codex use the service to claim approved tasks. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific MCP tools/resources exposed and per-client setup instructions, independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP endpoint works as described.
